title: Spain Deports 16 Migrants from Ceuta to Morocco; Amnesty Criticises
detail: Spain's Interior Ministry announced the first deportation of its kind since the July mass crossing: 16 people from African, Middle Eastern and Asian countries whose asylum applications were rejected were returned to Morocco, which agreed to receive them. Amnesty International said the move endangers migrants' human rights; Madrid says the EU considers Morocco a safe country and that safeguards were applied. About 8,000 migrants reportedly remain in Ceuta.
